insights.one_liner: Award-winning Amsterdam tech scale-up selling tickets to museums and attractions; English-language data and sales roles, highly competitive.

culture.text: Calls itself an award-winning tech scale-up with a mission to bring the world more ways to culture.
Its values: have fun and be creative, communicate honestly and support each other, and learn and pivot.
Current jobs here are 2 senior data roles and a supply sales internship in the Amsterdam area.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Tiqets International B.V.).
All 3 current jobs here don't require Dutch.
Roles draw about 152 LinkedIn applicants on average, so expect strong competition.

growth.text: Expedia's travel agent platform added Tiqets activities for selected UK agents.
